login.headline: Move sales, stock, and receiving from one calm console.
login.description: Puntovivo is built for operators who need checkout speed, stock visibility, and dependable control over purchasing and inventory flow.
login.signInDescription: Use your workstation credentials to access sales, inventory, purchasing, and settings for your business.
login.passwordMinLength: Password must be at least 6 characters
login.previousOperatorActive: This register is still assigned to another operator. Sign in as that operator, then use Sign out or Switch staff before changing accounts.

protected.loadingDescription: Restoring your session and access rules.

staffSwitch.title: Switch cashier
staffSwitch.description: Choose the cashier taking over this workstation and enter their 4-digit PIN.
staffSwitch.pinHint: PIN sessions expire after 8 hours and never grant manager or admin access.
staffSwitch.empty: No other active cashiers are available.

changePassword.title: Change Password
changePassword.successDescription: Please sign in again with your new password.
changePassword.requirements: Use a new password with at least 12 characters, plus uppercase, lowercase, number, and special character requirements.

throttled.title: Your session needs a moment
throttled.description: The server received too many requests. Wait before checking your session again.

unavailable.title: We could not verify your session
unavailable.description: The connection or service is temporarily unavailable. Check the connection, then try again.

recovery.safety: The workspace stays locked until the server verifies your identity. Draft carts remain linked to their original operator.
recovery.ready: Ready to check the connection. No retry runs automatically.
recovery.accountChangeFailed: The previous session could not be cleared. Try again before signing in.
recovery.cooldown: Please wait for the connection limit to reset.

pinLogin.title: Sign in with your PIN
pinLogin.description: Choose your name and enter your 4-digit PIN.
pinLogin.passwordHint: You can still sign in with your password.
pinLogin.noCandidatesHint: PINs now have 4 digits. After signing in with your password, set yours in "My PIN". Signing in with your password also unlocks a locked PIN.

myPin.title: My PIN
myPin.description: Set a 4-digit PIN to switch staff and approve requests at shared workstations and, on the desktop app, to sign in. Your current password is required to change or remove it.
